speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the nature of your vertigo and whether it is triggered by specific head movements or positions?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old male. The patient presents to the emergency department with a sudden-onset sensation that the room is spinning, leading to several episodes of nausea and vomiting. The symptoms started as he was going to bed and lasted for approximately 3 minutes. He mentions that he has never experienced anything like this before and currently feels at his baseline.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you experience any accompanying symptoms such as hearing loss, tinnitus, or a feeling of fullness in one ear? Also, did the vertigo return when you moved your head in a specific direction during the episode?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Sudden-onset sensation of the room spinning. I also have Nausea, Vomiting, Dizziness.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any history of migraines, or did you experience any hearing changes or tinnitus during the episode? I also need to know if you have any risk factors for stroke, such as high blood pressure or diabetes.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: The patient is otherwise healthy with only a history of eczema. No prior episodes of similar nature. Social history: No significant social history provided.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the vertigo recur with specific changes in head position, such as rolling over in bed or looking up, and is it associated with brief eye movements? I need to rule out Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo given the short duration and positional trigger.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies headaches, hearing loss, tinnitus, loss of consciousness or neurological deficits.

speaker: Doctor
text: Let me perform a Dix-Hallpike maneuver to check for nystagmus and reproduce your symptoms. I will also assess your gait and coordination to rule out central causes.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies headaches, hearing loss, tinnitus, loss of consciousness or neurological deficits.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: Dix-Hallpike Maneuver. REQUEST TEST: Head_Impulse_Test.
